# Agentlink is retired

Agentlink was retired on 2026-11-21, and v0.7.0 is the final release. Pull
requests are not being accepted. Report security issues privately as described
in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/snapsynapse/agentlink/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
The project is MIT licensed, so forks are welcome.
